description: This Java class implements a dummy credentials service for device registration in the Eclipse Hono framework. It provides a fixed hashed password for credentials retrieval, primarily used for testing or simulation purposes.

classes.name: DummyCredentialsService
classes.description: A dummy implementation of CredentialsService that returns a predefined hashed password for any credential request.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves credentials for a given tenant and authId, returning a fixed hashed password regardless of input.

methods.name: getBase64EncodedSha256HashForPassword
methods.description: Computes a Base64-encoded SHA-256 hash for the provided password string.
